Comentarios: The site is an the end of a valley, which means there is air coming right in front of you as soon as breeze is starting to blow : you can fly here during hours in the valley breeze. It's a very good site to learn soaring. It's very easy to go up, it's usually frequented by acro pilots for this reason.
Meteorología:
Worlwide known acro site. Is a place where thermals can be real strong on hot days, so be careful in the hot hours of the afternoon.  Also when the conditions are strong, care must be taken not to fall off to the back of the mountain since there's venturi effect there which accelerates the wind and also in the ridges to the east. A good rule of thumb will be not go northern past the antennas on the top unless you have quite a lot of altitude above them. So if the conditions are strong the best is to stay well on the face of the mountain. Landing options are not appealing in case one can't return to the valley and land north. Going down is easy, just fly south above the village and soon you'll get into the descendence. It's called the 'magic mountain' for a reason ;)
Also keep an eye for too much cloud development. The weather can change rather quickly. The pre-storm gusts can be dangerous.

Comentarios: This is the main launch site that is usable on 90 percent of good flyable days. There is a car park, a bar (not is use, and vandalised since 2001) and the take off area is divided into two sections: above and below the road. With nil wind it is generally better to take off below the road as it is steeper and if there is any danger of catabatic wind it affect the upper take off first. With a few km/hr of wind, the top take of is used. There is a fence to the rear, so if there is any chance of you being dragged back on a failed take off, it is best to prepare a little down slope. If you top land, the best area is the flatter area near the windsock on the west side of the upper launch. The whole area is a little rocky, and also there are a number of gorse bushes. We have been clearing the site by hand, improving it as best we can. For 2009 a significant improvement is anticipated with help of the local government and town hall with a budget of 31.000 euros.
Meteorología: On strong eastely forcasts it often appears fine at take off. This is shielding form the mountains, and out in the valley the wind can be strong and turbulent.

There are 4 takeoffs:

lowest take off is RAUDORAL.
Recently created, it allows take off without going all the way up to the top of the Montsec.Its a clean fairly steep takeoff that take a single paralider (while another prepares). It is faced South and is the first take off that comes the breeze while the slope is heated. BEWARE OF EAST WIND when we do not recommend use. Height to the Camping landing field: 500 m.
GPS: 31T 312693, 4656422

- GABRIELO.
It is a take off with a spacious zone to put the hang gliders and paragliders. We take off only for one point, and we should look all the streamers, because it is a technical take off. It is South faced, and not suitable with West winds. It is a good take off when the North wind on the top of Montsec. Height to Ager: 550m.
GPS: 31T 315102, 4655761

MAIN TOP TAKE OFF COLL D'ARES.
It is very big and clear take off. It has a few streamers to show the wind. It is South faced, but it allows to take off with West winds. If there is East wind, it is slightly in rotor. In an east it's better to continue to the Sant Alis take off. The height to Ager is 960 m. 
GPS: 31T 313555 , 4657599

- SANT ALIS.
It is geodesic vertex. It offers an incredible view: The Montseny, Moncayo, Guara mountain range, Pyrenees from Navarra to Girona, Montserrat, Monte Caro, Prades and Montsant mountain range. The take off is just on the left and in front of the firewatch cabin. It is South-East faced. Don't use with West winds. The height to Ager is 1050 m.
GPS: 31T 315237, 4656809

The take off is a grassy slope, in a large clearing in the pine forest which covers most off the hill. There is always a smell of wild Lavender and thyme, and the view out front toward the Gredos mountains and the river Tormes below are fantastic. On a day when we fly here it means that the wind is too strong from the south for the anabatic wind to come up the PeÃ±a Negra launch (on unstable days, southerly winds of more than 20km/hr can be stopped by the valley breeze at PeÃ±a Negra). Unless you get away early, the conditions can become too strong to take off. During the evening conditions usually lighten and provide excellent smooth ridge lift, occasionally with usable wave from the Gredos in front.

The face of the hill is steep, and has many granite fingers and ledges where the Griffon Vultures nest. When we fly here there are always vultures to accompany us.

Reglas de vuelo: ...Las habituales. No dejar vehículos obstaculizando maniobras y/o accesos a caminos secundarios ni despoerdigados por el monte. Mejor dejarlos aparcados a la orilla en el camino y subir los últimos 50m a pie.
Cómo llegar: Desde carretera de Ventas Blancas a Ribafrecha sale camino asfaltado que indica Zenzano. A un par de kilómetros a la derecha se encuentra una campa donde solemos dejar coches y usamos como aterrizaje oficial. Es fácil distinguirla aun cuando no haya mangas. El camino sigue asfaltado hasta una curva pronunciada a derecha, en el punto donde se pasa a la otra cara de la ladera. Nosotros tomamos curva a derecha para no cambiarnos de cara y seguimos por camino de tierra de estado irregular. Se puede subir turismos pero con muidado en los bajos y sin prisa ni mucho peos. Mejor furgos y TT. Otra opción es seguir por asfalto hasta el pueblo Zenzano (tras el despegue) y subir a pata unos 20 minutos.
Comentarios:
Zona de vuelo LER99 afectada por restricciones del aeropuerto civil y del militar, ambos en Agoncillo. Restricciones habituales : No volar entre semana antes de las 15:00 (posibles maniobras de helicópteros militares en la zona) Restricciones adicionales: Consultar NOTAM.
Adicionalmente y en caso de no haber restricciones, llamar a torre civil aeropuerto para dejar constancia de nuestra presencia indicando número de pilotos, zona de vuelo y horarios.
Meteorología: Se vuela con vientos de componente Norte y Oeste. Termoladera que funicona mejor a partir de las 15:00. Techos no muy altos, 2.200m de media. El mejor vuelo de distancia, ganando el llano por encima del aterrizaje oficial para poder luego aprovechar deriva siun que ésta nos meta en las sierras cercanas. Puede entrar el Norte fuerte a última hora en el despegue y casi seguro que se disparen Nortes o Noresetes en la duiirección antural del cross, conviente estar atento.

Descripción despegue: Poniente Take-off = 36.8952, -5.4157 – 900m
Cómo llegar:
A-384 out of Algodonales direction West: turn right, soon after the Cespa garage, then right towards La Muela after a few kilometres there is a right hand turning, keep heading for after La Muela. After a few hundred metres you pass the LZ for 'Poniente'… check the windsock and look around; it is not the most pleasant place to land due to the trees, valley and power lines. After La Muela, there is a gateway on the right to the picnic area and there is a sign: to the Launch Sites (from here on road is unpaved, rough, winding and often narrow, but no problem for 2WD, but watch out for returning vans!). 
If coming from 'Olvera' you can drive more directly to launch by taking the right turn towards 'la Muela' (CA-9101): turn-off after Olvera, at 36.9436033,-5.3086977, then as. 
Hiking to launch(es) is also possible and often done from the Poiniente Landing site,  la Muela and Algodonales.
Comentarios:
Excellent site for all kinds of pilots; summer months thermal activity is heavy, but evening flights are good. But then few are here anyway, as it's too hot with temperatures sometimes above 45°C between late June to early September. 

Poniente works well in the afternoon and evenings when Lavante stops.

There are several companies offering instruction and guiding in the town… it is a lively and fun place in season (spring and autumn).

Descripción despegue:
This is a PRIVATE site!! Only fly here when the clubs are on site. 

This is the lower take-off when it is a bit spicy on the top. Plenty of room for rigging and flying with trees and Pepe's Bar when busy.
Cómo llegar: Not much parking available, as it is along the road... keep tucked in or be prepared to walk a bit as it is quite narrow and there are always plenty of Club vans manoeuvring around.
